question: Which journalist’s autobiography is titled the ‘Devil’s Advocate: The untold story’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karan Thapar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karan Thapar **is an **Indian journalist**, **news presenter**, and **interviewer working with The Wire**.
 
• **Thapar **was associated with **CNN-IBN **and **hosted The Devil's Advocate **and **The Last Word**.
 
• He was born** **on **5 November 1955 **in **Srinagar**. 
 
• He has **written **many books: **Devil's Advocate, India Tonight, The Last Word, Face to Face (BBC); Hardtalk India (BBC), To The Point (India Today).**
 
• In Devil's Advocate, Karan dives deep into his life to come up with many such moments.
 
• Included here are stories of warm and lasting friendships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vir Sanghvi **__

 __
 
• **Vir Sanghvi** is an Indian print and television** journalist, author, columnist, and talk show host.**
 
• He has been a member of many professional, academic, and government bodies including the National Integration Council.
 
 
 
• **Prannoy Lal Roy**__
 __
 
• **Prannoy Lal Roy **is an Indian economist, **chartered accountant, psephologist, journalist, and author.**
 
• He is the executive co-chairperson of NDTV.
 
 
 
• **Vinod Dua **__
 
 
• **Vinod Dua** was an Indian journalist who** worked in Doordarshan** and NDTV India.
 
• He became the first electronic media journalist to be bestowed with the **Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Award. **
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri for Journalism in 2008** by the Government of India.
